test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a car reduces its speed by 10 km/h, it takes 1 hour more for a journey of 300 km. Find original speed.
solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 300 km

Decrease in speed = 10 km/h

Increase in time = 1 hour

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let original speed = x km/h

⇒ Time at original speed = 300 ÷ x

⇒ Time at reduced speed = 300 ÷ (x − 10)

⇒ 300 ÷ (x − 10) − 300 ÷ x = 1

⇒ 300x − 300(x − 10) ÷ x(x − 10) = 1

⇒ (300x − 300x + 3000) ÷ x(x − 10) = 1

⇒ 3000 ÷ x(x − 10) = 1

⇒ x(x − 10) = 3000

⇒ x² − 10x − 3000 = 0

⇒ x² − 60x + 50x − 3000 = 0

⇒ x(x − 60) + 50(x − 60) = 0

⇒ (x − 60)(x + 50) = 0

⇒ x = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km/h.**
